Fire a magical arrow at a target area, dealing damage and applying a stack of Deathseeker Arrows to enemies hit. Anya’s attacks reduce the recharge time of Withering Fire.

Level 1 - 100 damage, max 2 charges, recharges every 10 seconds, -0.5 seconds on attack.
Level 2 - 150 damage, max 2 charges, recharges every 10 seconds, -0.5 seconds on attack.
Level 3 - 175 damage, max 3 charges, recharges every 10 seconds, -0.5 seconds on attack.
Level 4 - 200 damage, max 3 charges, recharges every 10 seconds, -0.5 seconds on attack.
Level 5 - 250 damage, max 4 charges, recharges every 10 seconds, -0.5 seconds on attack.
